children: shares fell about 5% early Wednesday after the defense and space company outlined a $350 million convertible debt offering.

The proposed notes would mature Oct. 15, 2032, and are being marketed to qualified institutional buyers. Investors would receive the right to convert the debt under certain conditions, with Voyager able to settle conversions in cash, shares, or a combination of both.

Initial buyers could also purchase as much as $52.5 million of additional notes within 13 days of issuance, potentially lifting the total transaction to $402.5 million. The interest rate and conversion terms will be established when the offering is priced.

Voyager plans to direct part of the proceeds toward capped call transactions, which are designed to reduce potential dilution if the notes convert. The remaining funds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, including organic expansion and strategic acquisitions.

title: Voyager Technologies Stock Sinks After Unveiling $350 Million Convertible Notes
